cases.name: compile-main-script
cases.command: dotnet run -c Release --project AriaEngine.csproj -- aria-compile --init init.aria --main assets/scripts/main.aria --out ../../artifacts/replay/replay-check.ariac

cases.name: lint-main-script
cases.command: dotnet run -c Release --project AriaEngine.csproj -- aria-lint assets/scripts/main.aria

cases.name: flowcheck-umikaze-routes
cases.command: dotnet run -c Release --project AriaEngine.csproj -- aria-flowcheck --root . --main assets/scripts/main.aria --chapters 6 --execute

cases.name: validate-empty-release-saves
cases.command: dotnet run -c Release --project AriaEngine.csproj -- aria-save --dir ../../.tmp/replay-save-validation validate
